messages:
kevin: quick heads-up — I'm starting a candidate-calibration bench for the new reranker variant. goal: decouple score-scaling effects from ranking quality across quant configs and doc-formatting changes.
anya: nice. what's the minimum reproducible slice we need? small, fast-ish.
matt: prefer 5k queries, stratified by query length & intent. include golden set (~500) for absolute calibration checks.
sophia: agree. also include two doc formats: 'snippet' (short passage) and 'fulldoc' (concatenated paragraphs). that was where we saw shifts last time.
kevin: plan: run baseline fp16 vs q4x and q8 on same candidate pools. record per-query raw scores, normalized scores and topk positions. compute NDCG@5, MRR@10 and also per-slice delta.
anya: should we normalize per-query by max score or by softmax across candidates?
matt: both. keep raw_score, max_norm = score / max(scores), and softmax_norm = exp(score)/sum(exp). will help diagnose rescaling vs distributional shape changes.
sophia: add a tiny sketch of the bench config I used locally: 
```
{
  "queries": "5k_stratified.json",
  "candidates": "shared_candidate_pool.parquet",
  "formats": ["snippet","fulldoc"],
  "models": ["rerank-v2-fp16","rerank-v2-q4","rerank-v2-q8"],
  "metrics": ["ndcg@5","mrr@10","score_distrib_kls"]
}
```
kevin: nice. also capture score histograms per-candidate-type (exact match, partial, semantic). we saw semantic tail gets crushed under q4 previously.
eval-bot: bench job queued: bench/1724242424/candidate-calib (ETA 18m) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
anya: for holdout, let's shuffle candidate order and dedupe identical docs to avoid position bias.
matt: important: keep embed/retrieval layer fixed — we're isolating reranker-only changes. add metadata field "retrieval_version": "v2026-02-14".
sophia: can we add a small calibration plot step: per-slice reliability curve (predicted top1 prob vs empirical top1)? a calibration gap would point to simple rescaling fix.
kevin: yep, add reliability_curve and score_rescale_sweep (multiply scores by [0.9,1.0,1.1,1.2]) to see if simple scalar fixes reduce NDCG delta.
anya: for reporting, produce a table with columns: slice, metric, baseline, quant, delta, scale_adjusted_delta. keep csv-friendly.
emoji: kevin: :thumbsup:
matt: one more: log examples where raw_score rank changes but max_norm rank stays same — that'll show pure scale shift.
sophia: I'll prepare the golden queries and annotate expected top1 for ~200 of them. quick manual check will help catch semantic regressions not visible in aggregate metrics.
eval-bot: bench job started: bench/1724242424/candidate-calib (log: s3://redwood-evals/bench-1724242424/)
kevin: thanks. once we have results, we should run small AB rollout on dedicated pool with fallback to fp16 if delta > 0.01 ndcg@5 on golden.
anya: noted. ping me when results are in, I'll run the calibration-sweep step.
matt: agree. keep logs for random seed and batching config — quant nondeterminism has bitten us before.
sophia: adding that to bench config now, will push patch in 10m.
kevin: perfect. will follow up after bench completes.
